name: Unclaimed SOL Scanner
description: Scan and claim reclaimable SOL from dormant Solana wallet accounts. The first Vibe Claiming MCP server.

rawRecord.description: Scan and claim reclaimable SOL from dormant Solana wallet accounts. The first Vibe Claiming MCP server.

SOLANA_RPC_URL.description: Solana RPC endpoint. Defaults to https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com. A dedicated RPC is recommended for claiming.

SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private key as base58 string or JSON byte array. Use SOLANA_KEYPAIR_PATH instead when possible.

SOLANA_KEYPAIR_PATH.description: Path to Solana keypair JSON file. Enables Vibe Claiming.

SOLANA_PRIORITY_FEE.description: Priority fee in microlamports per compute unit. Default: 1,000. Max: 200,000.

UNCLAIMED_SOL_API_KEY.description: API key sent as Authorization: Bearer header.

UNCLAIMED_SOL_API_URL.description: Backend API URL. Defaults to https://unclaimedsol.com.
